deletion.title: Dzima akaundi
deletion.description: Akaundi yako inovharwa ipapo ipapo uye ruzivo rwako rwega runodzimwa zvachose mushure memazuva {{days}}.
consequences: Unobudiswa pamidziyo yose uye zviziviso zve push zvinomira ipapo ipapo.
Mushure memazuva {{days}}, purofiri yako, ruzivo rwekukubata, ruzivo rwako rwega nerwehutano rwekunyoresa kwako, nhoroondo yeGPS, vamhanyi vaunotevera nezviziviso zvinodzimwa.
Mibairo yemijaho nemarekodhi ekubhadhara zvinochengetwa chete zvisingakuzivikanise kana kuvimbika kwemijaho kana mutemo zvichizvida.
deletion.exportHint: Dhaunirodha kopi yeruzivo rwako kutanga kana uchirwuda.
deletion.recoveryHint: Wachinja pfungwa? Kusvikira zuva rekudzima, shandisa "Kanzura kudzimwa kweakaundi kwakamirira" papeji yekupinda neemail nepasiwedhi yako.
deletion.scheduledBody: Akaundi yako yavharwa uye yakarongerwa kudzimwa musi wa{{date}}. Uchiri kugona kukanzura zvisati zvaitika.
deletion.scheduledBodyNoDate: Akaundi yako yavharwa uye yakarongerwa kudzimwa. Uchiri kugona kukanzura zvisati zvaitika.
deletion.successBody: Akaundi yako yavharwa uye ichadzimwa musi wa{{date}}. Iye zvino uchabudiswa.
deletion.cancelFailed: Hatina kukwanisa kukanzura kudzimwa. Ndapota edza zvakare.

blockers.ACCOUNT_DELETION_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: Ndiwe wega mutungamiriri mukuru ari kushanda. Ita mumwe mushandisi kuti ave mutungamiriri mukuru usati wadzima akaundi iyi.
blockers.ACCOUNT_DELETION_ACTIVE_RACES: Ndiwe wega murongi ari kushanda wemujaho wakavhurika, wakavharwa kunyoresa, kana uri kuitika. Wedzera mumwe mutungamiriri wemujaho, kana pedzisa kana kanzura mujaho kutanga.

errors.ACCOUNT_DELETION_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Isa pasiwedhi yako kuti udzime akaundi yako.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Kuedza kwawandisa. Mira maminitsi mashoma wobva waedza zvakare.
